method: Read-only browser navigation through both pages of the zh-TW how-to and lifestyle public indexes; article titles and descriptions reviewed. No admin drafts queried.
travel_result: All 41 listed how-to articles correspond to the repository baseline; no additional competing title observed.
life_result: Existing topics are AI tools, product instructions, model concepts and AI-assisted workflows. This batch covers direct household/file organization and everyday methods; email triage is distinct from AI email drafting, and reading-note practice is distinct from AI study assistance.
limitations: This is a dated public-index snapshot, not a complete database export. Unpublished drafts and later publications remain outside the comparison. No production writes performed.
